title: Role Risk Lens: Member Assignment Sidecar for RBAC v2
creator: Asha Rao
description: Design a compact, context-aware sidecar panel for the Console role editor that surfaces a "risk lens" for each role and provides curated member assignment suggestions. The panel should help admins understand the downstream impact of assigning a member to a role by showing recent audit events for permission escalations, cross-tenant access signals, and a simulated impersonation preview. This ticket focuses on UX flows, copy, micro-interactions, and hand-off artifacts for engineering and security review. The goal is to reduce assignment mistakes and speed up safe onboarding of members across tenant boundaries.
acceptance_criteria: Sidecar opens from role editor and docks to the right without obscuring core fields
Displays a concise risk summary (High/Medium/Low) with rationale and recent audit highlights
Shows top 3 suggested members for the role with confidence score and source signal (SAML group, previous role history, manager suggestion)
Impersonation preview simulates effective permissions for a selected member and highlights risky permissions
Action controls: Assign, Schedule assignment, Add temporary elevation with TTL, and Revert last assignment
All copy reviewed by security and legal; design tokens and accessibility (AA) verified
Figma frames, interaction specs, and an itemized handoff doc provided for ENG-8112 and ENG-8249
dev_notes: Needs a small telemetry ping on open/assign actions for cost analysis (align with ENG logging schema)
Work with security to ensure impersonation preview does not perform live elevation; use simulated policy engine outputs
Recommend lazy-loading audit events and caching last-30-days for performance
Consider fallback when audit store is unavailable: show stale badge and basic permission list only
